message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout that turned into a cozy little adventure! I grabbed my trusty flashlight and a couple of lanterns, set them up around the living room, and we all piled onto the couch with snacks and board games. It felt like a mini camping trip right in our own home! I even charged my phone with a power bank so we could still listen to music. It reminded me that sometimes, unexpected moments can turn into the best memories. What’s your favorite way to make a blackout feel special?
